text:
Ella: Quick review of the Prompt Sets + Evals list mock I posted. Key asks: compact list default, inline expand for full prompt + diff, and a bulk-approve flow that writes to audit. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/ps-evals-v3

Omar: Backend Qs: bulk approve require reason? one shared reason or per-item? need to know audit schema.

Sasha: UX: default compact with 140-char preview. Chevron expands inline to show full prompt + small diff summary + 'View full diff'. Lazy-load diffs on expand.

Sasha: Selection: tri-state parent checkbox, Shift+click range select, and a header "12 selected" counter when items chosen.

James: A11y: keyboard nav (Up/Down), Enter to expand, Space to select, A to approve opens modal. Use aria-expanded/aria-controls on chevrons and role=alert for toasts. Contrast: token #9aa0a6 fails at 13px, suggest #4b5563.

Priya: Modal must trap focus and initial focus on textarea. On success announce "12 tests approved" and move focus to audit link. Test NVDA/VoiceOver.

Ella: Decision: require a batch reason (single string) stored with audit. Button label: "Approve selected" and enforce required reason.

Omar: Will add POST /audits/bulk_review { actor_id, test_ids[], batch_reason } -> { audit_id }. Will include diff_hashes[].

Sasha: I'll prototype compact toggle + keyboard map and include a demo.

James: I'll run a11y pass on the branch (focus traps + contrast).

Ella: Sync tomorrow 10am PT to finalize copy and shortcuts. Thanks! :sparkles:
